description: This file is a shell script used for testing and automating workflows related to git p4 integration, perforce server triggers, and repository management. It contains test cases for starting a p4 server, initializing depots, cloning, importing, and submitting changes with verbose trigger lines.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up the git repository used during tests.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup actions to execute after tests are complete.

methods.description: Checks if the specified path is a file.
